PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Handling Waste Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Handling Waste Materials.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Handling Waste Materials.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Handling Waste Materials.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Handling Waste Materials.

2. When learning Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

4. When learning Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

6. When learning Self- Exploration and Career Development, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Self- Exploration and Career Development.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Self- Exploration and Career Development.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Self- Exploration and Career Development.

7. When learning Wood, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Wood.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wood.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wood.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wood.

8. When learning Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.

9. When learning Oblique Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Oblique Projection.

   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Holding Tools.

11. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester

12. When learning Safety on Raised Platforms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Safety on Raised Platforms.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety on Raised Platforms.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Government and Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Business Plan 6 Total Number of Lessons 120 Note: The suggested number of lesson and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
